ops.title: Tilskud til lys og lyd ved stævner
ops.reason: Both rules hold the same subsidy for clubs renting light and sound equipment for meets: the board's 2010 proposal and the representatives' decision introducing it.

Both rules regulate the same entry and entry-fee payment deadline for meets, with exclusion if the fee is unpaid; the decisions were filed under identical subjects (documentation of paid fee, tilmelding og betaling af startgebyr).

ops.title: Arrangørtilskud ved DM-Hold (divisionsturnering)
ops.reason: Both rules set the subsidy DSF pays clubs for hosting division-tournament rounds (10,000 kr. for three rounds vs. 5,000 kr. per round), so they are versions of one rule.
The 6-month rule is the waiting period on the licence list before a lifter may compete, later set at 3 months; the rejected proposal to abolish it belongs to that rule.

parts.title: Bestilling, betaling og levering af medaljer og pokaler

ops.reason: The rule mixes which championships award discipline medals with who orders, pays for and delivers medals and trophies; these are separate rules.
The rule is an amendment to the statutes (§13) giving Stævneudvalget the power to change championships, which is a committee power and belongs under organisation.
